The '''Semblan eel''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sembla/Legends|Sembla]], which featured enormous coral reefs in its [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Semblan eel was discovered among the reefs for the first time by explorers.<ref name="Reefs" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Semblan eel was first mentioned in the Bioanalysis crewskill mission "The Reefs of Sembla" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Reefs" />
